About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the compute that trains and serves our frontier models. Behind every cluster is a physical supply chain: servers, accelerators, networking equipment, spares, and tooling that have to be received, inspected, secured, tracked, and delivered to the right site at the right time. The Warehousing and Logistics team owns that flow, and this role runs its day-to-day operations outside North America as the operations expand to new geographies.
As Warehouse and Logistics Manager, you'll report to our Global Warehousing and Logistics Lead and own the operational management of all direct and third party logistics providers of inbound receiving, storage, inventory control, kitting, and outbound shipments to our data center sites and partners.

You'll manage the relationships and performance of our third-party warehouses, carriers, and freight forwarders, and you'll be the person on the ground when a shipment is late, a pallet arrives damaged, or a site needs a critical spare tomorrow morning.
This is a hands-on operational role on a small team, so you'll move between running the daily floor rhythm and building the processes, controls, and metrics that let us scale as our hardware footprint grows. You should be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, communicating clearly with engineers and vendors alike, and holding a high bar for accuracy and chain of custody on high-value, security-sensitive equipment.

Oversee the day-to-day warehouse operations across international locations through management of third party logistics providers, including receiving, inspection, put-away, storage, cycle counting, kitting, and outbound fulfillment to data center sites
Own inventory accuracy and asset tracking for all infrastructure hardware, compute, MEP, spares, and consumables, maintaining clear chain of custody from dock to rack
Plan and execute domestic freight and coordinate international shipments, selecting carriers, managing schedules, and resolving exceptions such as delays, damage, and shortages
Manage third-party logistics providers, carriers, and freight forwarders, including onboarding, service-level tracking, performance reviews, and cost management
Coordinate closely with data center operations, hardware engineering, procurement, and security teams to align delivery schedules with deployment timelines and site readiness
Operate reverse logistics for returns, RMAs, and end-of-life equipment, including secure handling and disposition of storage devices in partnership with security and compliance
Build and document standard operating procedures, checklists, and controls for warehouse and shipping activities, and train warehouse staff and vendors on them
Maintain compliance with safety, hazardous materials, export control, and customs requirements for the equipment we handle
Define and report on operational metrics such as receiving cycle time, inventory accuracy, on-time delivery, and freight cost, and use them to drive continuous improvement
Support capacity planning for warehouse space, staffing, and equipment as our hardware volumes and site count grow

Vendor negotiation & 3PL management: Manage relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and 3PL partners, negotiating competitive rates and service contracts on behalf of the logistics department.
KPIs, budget & SLA oversight: Establish, track, and report performance metrics (on-time delivery, freight spend variances, customs clearance lead times) to drive continuous cost optimization and operational excellence.

Customs & trade expertise: Deep knowledge of international customs regulations, import/export compliance, HS codes, temporary importations (e.g., ATA Carnets), and duty optimization.
Team leadership: 3+ years of experience direct managing logistics coordinators or operations teams across multiple regions and time zones.
Strategic & financial analysis: Strong capability to analyze logistics trade-offs (e.g., shipping vs. local fabrication) and manage departmental budgets, vendor quotes, and KPIs.
Vendor negotiation: Proven track record negotiating high-value contracts and freight rates with global 3PLs, carriers, and customs brokers.
Education & tools: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or equivalent experience; proficiency in TMS/ERP platforms, Google Sheets/Excel, and analytics tools.
Communication & adaptability: Fluent English with excellent stakeholder management skills to explain complex trade/logistics issues to non-technical teams in a fast-paced environment.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
As a Refined Products Inventory Analyst, you will play a central role in powering Kpler's storage intelligence and driving the expansion of our brand-new inventory product from regional hubs to global coverage .

Operating at the intersection of data operations, satellite imagery validation, and oil market analysis, you will ensure the precision, completeness, and strategic value of our global refined products dataset .

By mapping terminal infrastructure and translating complex data into actionable market intelligence, you will directly empower commodity traders and market participants to navigate evolving energy dynamics with confidence .

Map and classify terminal infrastructure: Identify, map, and classify refined product storage assets, blending units, and interconnection networks by product category and operational function .
Validate satellite imagery and aerial data: Utilize satellite and thermal imagery to verify storage tank structures, estimate fill capacities, and detect operational shifts or anomalies across key energy hubs .
Optimize data workflows: Design and streamline scalable procedures for terminal onboarding, quality assurance, and automated processing in collaboration with engineering and data operations teams .
Integrate market and refinery context: Apply operational knowledge of refinery storage, blending processes, and transport dynamics (pipeline, barge, truck, ship) to maintain high data integrity during market disruptions or maintenance events .
Support regional and global expansion: Lead the data rollout from current European and North American hubs to global coverage, establishing robust methodologies for new geographical regions .
Collaborate cross-functionally and support commercial teams: Partner with internal research, commercial, and product teams to share methodology, gather client feedback, and support sales enablement .
Lead responses to ad-hoc client requests with rapid, well-structured analysis: Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to address client data needs and feed insights back into internal systems.
Experience & Background

5+ years of experience in inventory intelligence, terminal logistics, or oil market data analytics and operations .
Demonstrated capability in working with satellite, aerial, or thermal imagery to validate asset structures and extract operational intelligence .
Strong technical comfort with data handling tools such as Excel, SQL, or Python to process and audit complex datasets .
Proven ability to think autonomously, build operational workflows from scratch, and resolve granular data issues in a remote work environment .

In-depth understanding of refined products storage infrastructure (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, fuel oil), including tank functions, blending operations, and dispatch practices .
Experience collaborating cross-functionally across product, engineering, and commercial teams within a commodity or market data environment .

We are hiring a Logistics Manager to help scale Yepoda's global inbound logistics operations across air and ocean freight. In this hands-on role, you will own end-to-end shipment flow from manufacturing sites to warehouses, and balance strategic freight forwarder management with day-to-day operational execution.
Your Tasks
Manage end-to-end inbound logistics from manufacturing sites to warehouses, covering international air and ocean freight.
Lead freight forwarder management, including rate negotiations, provider nominations, shipment bookings, service performance, and issue resolution.
Ensure proactive shipment tracking and exception management, addressing delays, capacity constraints, documentation issues, and other logistics disruptions.
Provide customs brokers with accurate and timely shipment, product, and commercial data required for customs clearance, and support resolution of clearance-related queries.
Maintain accurate shipment, transport, and inventory movement data in the ERP system.
Coordinate inter-warehouse transfers based on transfer requirements defined by Procurement, including transport arrangements, system transactions, and follow-up through to completion.
Monitor and report key logistics KPIs, including freight cost, transit time, on-time delivery, and service-provider performance.
Drive logistics optimization and operational excellence through strategic, data-driven decision-making and continuous process improvement.
Act as the main point of contact for logistics topics, coordinating with manufacturing sites, warehouses, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal stakeholders.
Mentor and develop a junior colleague, fostering knowledge sharing, capability building, and continuous growth within the team.
Act as backup for the Fulfillment Manager during planned absence, ensuring continuity of critical fulfillment activities.
Your Profile
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Min. 4 years of professional experience in an international logistics or supply chain environment.
Good understanding of global transportation, Incoterms, and customs-related requirements.
Commercial mindset with confidence in negotiations and supplier/service-provider discussions.
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with ERP systems, data, KPIs, and Google Workspace.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Proactive and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and sound decision-making skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across different functions and external partners.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

# **Logisticien Commercial Junior - Supply Chain & Transport** #
### A propos du rôle ###
En tant que Logisticien Commercial Junior, vous jouez un rôle pivot entre l'opérationnel et le commercial. Vous travaillez en binôme avec la direction pour optimiser les flux mondiaux tout en développant activement le réseau de partenaires internationaux.
**Nous vous proposons**
Des déplacements internationaux stimulants (Asie, Amérique du Sud) et de fortes perspectives d'évolution vers des responsabilités managériales.
## Tâches ##
Ce rôle combine la gestion opérationnelle des flux logistiques (70% maritime) et le support stratégique au développement commercial à l'international.
* Organiser et suivre les expéditions maritimes (FCL/LCL), routières et multimodales
* Analyser les coûts, les itinéraires et les transit times pour optimiser les flux cross-trade
* Rechercher, qualifier et mettre en concurrence les transporteurs et transitaires
* Négocier les tarifs de transport et sécuriser les capacités logistiques
* Développer de nouvelles routes logistiques vers l'Asie, l'Afrique et l'Amérique Latine
* Réaliser des analyses comparatives pour recommander les meilleures options de transport
* Accompagner le développement commercial lors de déplacements internationaux réguliers
### Nous cherchons ###
* Première expérience réussie en logistique, idéalement dans le secteur maritime et conteneurs
* Maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais
* Esprit entrepreneurial et orientation solutions
* Esprit analytique capable de transformer des données brutes en recommandations stratégiques
**Un atout si vous possédez**
* Études supérieures spécialisées en Supply Chain Management
* Maîtrise de l'espagnol ou du portugais pour les échanges internationaux
**Pour réussir dans cette fonction, vos compétences personnelles sont les suivantes :**
* Orientation au changement
* Organisation
* Curiosité intellectuelle
## Notre processus de recrutement ##
Ce processus de recrutement est géré par Academic Work et notre client souhaite que toutes les questions concernant le poste soient adressées à Academic Work.
Notre processus de sélection est continu et l'annonce peut être clôturée avant la fin du processus de recrutement si nous sommes passés à la phase suivante. Le processus comprend des tests qui sont des outils permettant de trouver le bon talent pour le bon poste, de favoriser l'égalité, la diversité et un processus équitable.

s.t:
Arrow Electronics (www.arrow.com) is a global provider of products, services, and solutions for industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions.

Arrow serves as a supply partner to more than 150,000 Original equipment manufacturers, value-added resellers, contract manufacturers and commercial customers through a global network. The company maintains more than 300 sales locations and 45 distribution and service centers in over 80 countries.

Arrow serves markets including telecommunications, communications systems, automotive, medical, industrial technology, and consumer electronics. Arrow provides value to its customers and manufacturers through specialized services and technical expertise throughout the product lifecycle.

Arrow is a Fortune 500 company and has more than 22,000 employees worldwide.
For our European team we are hiring a Supply Chain Services Manager (Northern Europe)
Based remotely in the UK, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Netherlands, Poland, Hungary or the Czech Republic
The position holder, in collaboration with the sales teams, will make use of the full set of Arrow’s enterprise solutions, a growth mind-set and a consultative selling approach to both traditional and non-traditional customers.

By targeting VP-level+ customer influencers and decision-makers (sometimes autonomously from the sales team), he/she will differentiate Arrow from our competitors, resulting in sales, margin and fee growth and a leading share of TAM.

He/she will become the subject matter expert and owner of the sales funnel for Arrow’s fee-for-service portfolio, including but not limited to: Supply chain resilience programs, segregated supply chains, In-house semiconductor programming services, Long-term inventory solutions, Turnkey Manufacturing Services, Supply Chain Control Tower (visibility tools).

The position holder will have solid knowledge of the full One Arrow portfolio of business units including: Arrow Intelligent Solutions, Converge, Arrow Digital, Enterprise Computing Solutions, eInfochips, Arrow Supply Assurance, Richardson RFPD, Silicon Expert, AGSCS (Arrow Global Supply Chain Services), AMSS (Turnkey Manufacturing Services).

Build a detailed knowledge of Arrow’s high-end supply chain solutions portfolio
Use consultative questioning techniques to isolate the customer pain points. Create compelling bespoke solutions to meet the customer need
Develop a deep understanding and comfort in the use of quantitative and qualitative approaches to support the benefits statement. Demonstrate success by increasing Arrow’s share of the customer’s wallet
Collaborate with the sales teams, using tools such as whitespace analysis to spotlight high potential customers
Build strategies to connect with the customer influencers and decision-makers
Develop an understanding of Arrow’s financial objectives ensuring that any solution design meets the thresholds within an acceptable period
The maintenance of implemented supply chain solutions to be handed-off to a combination of Sales and Business Process Excellence

Problem solving and creation of winning strategies
Fast-learner, can-do attitude, excellent communication skills
Project management skills and teamwork spirit
Fluent English language skills, spoken and written

Unsere Mandantin ist ein etabliertes Schweizer Unternehmen mit einer starken Marktposition und einer schweizweiten Organisation. Für die Weiterentwicklung des Einkaufs suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt, Menschen zusammenbringt und pragmatische Lösungen entwickelt.
In dieser Führungsrolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die operative Beschaffung und führen ein eingespieltes Team. Dabei geht es nicht darum, Bestehendes einfach weiterzuführen. Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit, Abläufe zu hinterfragen, die Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Bereiche hinweg zu verbessern und den Einkauf gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team weiterzuentwickeln.
## Das erwartet Sie ##
Sie sorgen gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team dafür, dass Materialien zuverlässig, wirtschaftlich und zum richtigen Zeitpunkt verfügbar sind. Gleichzeitig behalten Sie den Blick fürs Ganze und entwickeln Strukturen und Arbeitsweisen dort weiter, wo es sinnvoll ist.

s.h: Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören unter anderem
s.t:
* Führung und Weiterentwicklung des Beschaffungsteams
* Koordination der operativen Einkaufsaktivitäten
* Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Zusammenarbeit
* Pflege und Entwicklung wichtiger Lieferantenbeziehungen
* Begleitung von Verhandlungen und kommerziellen Vereinbarungen
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Category Management, Supply Chain und Verkauf
* Sicherstellung einer zuverlässigen und wirtschaftlichen Warenversorgung
* Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung von Systemen und digitalen Prozessen
## Das bringen Sie mit ##
Wir suchen keine Theoretiker, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die Einkauf versteht, gerne mit Menschen arbeitet und Veränderungen mit Augenmass vorantreibt.
Sie bringen Erfahrung im Einkauf oder in der Beschaffung mit und haben bereits Teams geführt. Ein Hintergrund aus dem Baustoffhandel, technischen Handel oder einem industriellen Umfeld ist von Vorteil.

* Freude an Führung und an der Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden
* Ein gutes Verständnis für Einkaufs- und Supply-Chain-Prozesse
* Verhandlungsgeschick und unternehmerisches Denken
* Eine strukturierte und gleichzeitig pragmatische Arbeitsweise
* Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise SAP
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Französischkenntnisse
* Bereitschaft, innerhalb der Schweiz unterwegs zu sein
## Was die Aufgabe besonders macht ##
Hier finden Sie eine Führungsaufgabe mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Die Beschaffung hat innerhalb des Unternehmens einen hohen Stellenwert und soll sich auch in Zukunft weiterentwickeln.
Sie können eigene Ideen einbringen, Prozesse vereinfachen und gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team eine moderne, gut vernetzte Beschaffungsorganisation mitgestalten. Dabei arbeiten Sie mit unterschiedlichen internen Ansprechpartner zusammen und bewegen sich in einem bodenständigen, unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld.
Sie erwarten attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, zeitgemässe Arbeitsmittel, gute Vorsorgeleistungen sowie ein Firmenfahrzeug, das auch privat genutzt werden kann.
## Interessiert? ##
Sie möchten Einkauf nicht nur organisieren, sondern gemeinsam mit einem Team weiterentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Möchtest du die komplexen Abläufe globaler Lieferketten aktiv mitgestalten? Bei uns erhältst du die Gelegenheit, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und reale Prozesse zur Sicherstellung unserer Kundenversorgung zu optimieren.
Während deines Praktikums koordinierst du die Supply Chain, um die reibungslose Kundenversorgung sicherzustellen.
Bei der operativen Durchführung der Kunden- und Lieferantenplanung unterstützt du unser Team tatkräftig.
Deine Mitarbeit ist auch in spannenden Teilprojekten entlang der gesamten Supply Chain gefragt.
Eigenverantwortlich koordinierst du unser internes Ausleihsystem für Hardware und Produkte.
Kundenanfragen und -reklamationen bearbeitest du professionell und lösungsorientiert.
Regelmäßig erstellst du aussagekräftige KPI-Reportings, die als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen.
Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich Logistik, Materialwirtschaft, Produktionslehre oder vergleichbar
Erfahrungen und Know-how: Kenntnisse in Materialwirtschaft, Logistik oder Produktionslehre; sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; SAP-Kenntnisse; praktische Erfahrungen in der Logistik
Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: du handelst eigenverantwortlich und zielorientiert, ergreifst gerne die Initiative und bringst dich gleichzeitig als kommunikativer Teamplayer ein
Arbeitsalltag: wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten
Begeisterung: Spaß an der Arbeit in einem agilen und dynamischen Start-Up-Umfeld
Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch
Beginn: ab Februar 2027
Dauer: 6 Monate - 40h/Woche
Voraussetzung für das Praktikum ist die Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule. Bitte füge deiner Bewerbung deinen Lebenslauf, deinen aktuellen Notenspiegel, deine Zeugnisse für praktische Tätigkeiten, eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung, deine Prüfungsordnung sowie ggf. eine gültige Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis bei.
Vielfalt und Inklusion sind für uns keine Trends, sondern fest verankert in unserer Unternehmenskultur. Daher freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen: unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität.

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Schlüsselposition übernehmen Sie die fachliche und personelle Führung der Produktionslogistik und stellen die optimale Materialversorgung der Fertigung sicher.

Dabei liegt der Fokus nicht auf der klassischen Transport\- oder Lagerlogistik, sondern auf der effizienten Steuerung sämtlicher innerbetrieblichen Materialflüsse entlang der Wertschöpfungskette.

This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling production flow and supporting launch manifest and key developmental goals.

Working in close coordination with engineering and manufacturing departments, supply chain planners execute effective creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.

Reporting to the Vice President, Delivery, the SAP Supply Chain Domain Architect is Talan’s functional authority for supply chain planning and execution processes across multiple clients and engagements. The role covers demand and supply planning in SAP IBP, order to cash, sourcing and procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics, and the connection between planning and manufacturing.
You step in when decisions require a deep understanding of how SAP works and of end-to-end process handoffs. Working with Sales, solution, and delivery teams, you shape solutions, approve functional designs, arbitrate gaps against standard, and safeguard the coherence of planning, master data, inventory, and logistics execution.

Consultative intelligence Provide the deep functional expertise required to shape solutions by distinguishing standard capabilities, genuine gaps, and the choice among configuration, extension, or process change.
Lead Supply Chain workstreams in digital discovery and readiness assessments, then present recommendations, estimates, assumptions, and trade-offs in workshops, proposals, and oral presentations.
Assess the end-to-end implications of planning and execution choices for availability, inventory, customer promise, procurement, warehousing, transport, and manufacturing.
Technical and functional expertise Define and uphold the functional architecture for the domain, including SAP IBP, order to cash, sourcing and procurement, inventory management, SAP EWM, SAP TM touchpoints, and the planning-to-production connection.
Configure and prototype complex scenarios when design decisions cannot be settled on paper, then confirm the end-to-end behaviour of master data and process handoffs.
Guide decisions involving demand planning, response and supply, inventory optimization, S&OP, advanced ATP, pricing, rebates, and condition contract management.
Problem solving and analytical thinking Review and approve functional designs, specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, and workflows, and the domain’s critical test strategies and scripts.
Support defect analysis during system integration, user acceptance, and regression testing, then resolve domain escalations through cutover, hypercare, and transition into AMS.
Guide data migration and cutover decisions, with particular attention to master data and the quality thresholds that determine the reliability of planning and execution results.
Leadership, vision and initiative Act as the Supply Chain design authority across multiple concurrent engagements and serve as the quality gate before deliverables reach clients.
Coach functional consultants through design reviews, contribute to interviews and onboarding, and identify the capabilities the practice must develop, train, or hire.
Track the SAP roadmap for the domain and brief the practice on changes that affect the standard approach, clean core, and cloud solutions.
Knowledge sharing Create and maintain reusable process models, configuration accelerators, demo environments and scripts, guides, and design patterns for presales and delivery.
Capture engagement lessons and patterns in practice intellectual property and contribute domain content to AI-enabled delivery tools and the internal knowledge base.

SAP experience: At least twelve (12) years of SAP experience, including at least ten (10) years of hands-on configuration in Supply Chain, with a track record as the domain escalation point.
SAP S/4HANA achievements: Participation in at least four (4) SAP S/4HANA projects on current releases, including at least one greenfield implementation or selective transition where the candidate owned domain design.
Participation in at least (1) end-to-end Public Cloud project.
Design authority: At least three (3) years reviewing and approving other people’s functional designs, with demonstrated experience supporting multiple concurrent engagements.
Planning: Hands-on SAP IBP experience across at least two of demand, response and supply, inventory optimization, and S&OP, including planning-model configuration.
Supply chain execution: Expertise in order to cash, including advanced ATP, pricing, and rebates or condition contract management, and in sourcing and procurement, including where SAP Ariba fits.
Logistics and manufacturing: Experience with warehousing and logistics execution using embedded or decentralized SAP EWM, transportation touchpoints, and the planning-to-production connection.
Industries: Working credibility in at least two of Mining, Oil and Gas, Consumer Packaged Goods, and Industrial Manufacturing.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Conditions: Canada-based remote role with client travel across North America representing approximately 20% to 40% of working time.
Communication: Good oral and written communication skills in English, to communicate with clients located across North America.
Assets
Exposure to Consumer Packaged Goods demand planning and promotional forecasting or to mining logistics and concentrate movement.
Consulting experience with a Big Four firm or SAP partner, experience building reusable accelerators, and experience with SAP public cloud and clean-core constraints.
Exposure to SAP GTS, SAP Transportation Management, or third-party logistics integration.
SAP Integrated Business Planning certification preferred; SAP S/4HANA certification in Sourcing and Procurement, Sales, or Supply Chain; SAP EWM or SAP TM certification and APICS CPIM or CSCP designation considered assets.

Se rapportant au Gestionnaire, conseiller D365, et membre clé de l'équipe Microsoft, le/la Consultant(e) Sénior ERP joue un rôle stratégique dans l'accompagnement de nos clients vers l'optimisation de leurs processus logistiques. Vous dirigerez des projets d'implantation ERP à forte valeur ajoutée, en transformant les besoins d'affaires en solutions fonctionnelles concrètes et performantes.
En tant qu'expert(e) reconnu(e) en logistique sur Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O, vous mettrez à profit votre savoir-faire pour modéliser, configurer et déployer des solutions innovantes, assurant l'efficacité opérationnelle et la croissance de nos clients. Votre contribution sera directe et tangible, de l'analyse initiale à la mise en production, garantissant l'alignement technologique avec les objectifs stratégiques.

Connaissance métier & Expertise fonctionnelle
Analyser en profondeur les besoins d'affaires des clients et les traduire en solutions fonctionnelles robustes dans D365 F&O, notamment pour la gestion des entrepôts (WMS), des stocks, des achats, des ventes et de la distribution.
Assurer une veille technologique constante sur les évolutions du module Supply Chain de D365 F&O pour proposer des solutions à la pointe de l'innovation.
Excellence Opérationnelle & Gestion de projet
Intervenir sur toutes les phases du cycle de vie des projets ERP, du cadrage à la mise en service et au support post-implantation, en garantissant l'atteinte des objectifs de qualité et de performance.
Élaborer une documentation fonctionnelle rigoureuse (cahiers des charges, scénarios de test, guides utilisateurs) et paramétrer les modules pour une optimisation maximale.
Partage des connaissances & Encadrement
Encadrer les consultants juniors, partager les meilleures pratiques internes et contribuer activement au développement des compétences collectives de l'équipe.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques pour garantir l'intégration fluide des solutions avec les autres modules D365 F&O (finance, production).
Communication & Relations clients
Animer des ateliers clients, fournir des conseils stratégiques et guider les clients dans leurs choix technologiques et organisationnels.
Établir et maintenir des relations de confiance avec les clients et les parties prenantes, en assurant une communication claire et efficace tout au long des projets.
Reporting to the D365 Consultant Manager, and a key member of the Microsoft team, the Senior ERP Logistics Consultant plays a strategic role in supporting our clients in optimizing their logistics processes. You will lead high-value ERP implementation projects, transforming business needs into concrete and high-performing functional solutions.
As a recognized expert in logistics on Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O, you will leverage your expertise to model, configure, and deploy innovative solutions, ensuring operational efficiency and client growth. Your contribution will be direct and tangible, from initial analysis to production, ensuring technological alignment with strategic objectives.

Business Knowledge & Functional Expertise
Thoroughly analyze client business needs and translate them into robust functional solutions within D365 F&O, particularly for Warehouse Management (WMS), inventory management, purchasing, sales, and distribution.
Maintain constant technological watch on developments in the D365 F&O Supply Chain module to propose cutting-edge innovative solutions.
Operational Excellence & Project Management
Intervene in all phases of ERP project lifecycles, from scoping to go-live and post-implementation support, ensuring the achievement of quality and performance objectives.
Develop rigorous functional documentation (specifications, test scenarios, user guides) and configure modules for maximum optimization.
Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship
Mentor junior consultants, share internal best practices, and actively contribute to the collective skill development of the team.
Collaborate closely with technical teams to ensure seamless integration of solutions with other D365 F&O modules (finance, production).
Communication & Client Relations
Facilitate client workshops, provide strategic advice, and guide clients in their technological and organizational choices.
Establish and maintain trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders, ensuring clear and effective communication throughout projects.
